dedupe_keys.name: wp5 tst tunable vcsel results v1

description: Alberto Gatto, Paola Parolari and Pierpaolo Boffi of Politecnico di Milano provide experimental characterisation of a 7-GHz tunable vertical-cavity surface-emitting laser. The XLSX workbook reports emitted optical power and wavelength as functions of bias current, MEMS current and temperature. It also records performance of 8-GHz discrete-multitone modulation, with and without vestigial-sideband filtering, over up to 40 kilometres of single-mode fibre. These source-defined component and link measurements support communication-system performance modelling and comparison. Zenodo makes the workbook freely available under CC BY 4.0. The related PASSION network-planning record concerns the same project but has a separate purpose; a direct input relationship is not established. A limitation is that the inspected metadata does not give experiment dates, temporal sampling, tested current ranges or uncertainty estimates. No workbook cells or numerical validation results were inspected.
